text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d s-h-a-d-o-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s f-o-r a f-a-k-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w n-e-t-w-o-r-k, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d b-o-t t-o-k-e-n-s a-n-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l f-i-l-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d h-u-m-a-n i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-u-a-l-l-y f-o-r-c-e-d a-c-c-e-p-t-a-n-c-e d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n-s o-n t-h-e i-r-o-n-c-l-a-d-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a-n-d s-u-b-s-e-q-u-e-n-t p-u-b-l-i-c a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-u-b-s-t-a-n-t-i-v-e r-e-v-i-e-w a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-u-i-l-t a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s t-o r-e-j-e-c-t a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d b-a-s-e-l-e-s-s r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s a-n-d r-e-p-l-i-c-a-b-l-e f-i-l-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w o-f t-h-e r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n r-e-a-s-o-n-s
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-m-i-t-t-e-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-e-c-t-i-o-n-s f-r-o-m t-h-e e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l s-y-s-t-e-m-s u-s-e-d, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d u-n-d-e-c-l-a-r-e-d f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-t-e-n-d-e-d t-h-e f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s w-e-r-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t t-o t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m-s d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d r-e-v-i-e-w-s a-n-d t-r-a-c-k-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l f-o-r e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w-s
